summary: REQ-16 appears implemented by setting createdAt during post creation using the current time (via toUnixSeconds(Time.now())). REQ-17 is only partially addressed: a migration is added and wired in, but it unconditionally overwrites createdAt for all posts to a hardcoded timestamp rather than conditionally correcting only invalid timestamps and specifically ensuring the "Backroads Litter" post renders as 08 January 2026 in Australia/Sydney.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use a conditional, upgrade-safe migration to permanently correct invalid persisted createdAt values (e.g., 0/epoch-like) without overwriting valid timestamps.
missing_requirements.reason: The migration shown overwrites createdAt for every post, not just invalid ones, and does not demonstrate any conditional logic to detect and fix only invalid timestamps.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the existing post titled "Backroads Litter" specifically gets a createdAt that renders as "08 January 2026" in Australia/Sydney timezone, while leaving other posts' valid createdAt values intact.
missing_requirements.reason: The migration does not check the title "Backroads Litter" (or any identifier) and instead sets the same hardcoded createdAt for all posts; this does not implement targeted correction for that specific post.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration hardcodes createdAt = 1767878400 for all existing posts, effectively changing every post date to 08 Jan 2026.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asks to correct invalid createdAt values and to ensure the specific "Backroads Litter" post renders as 08 January 2026; it does not request overwriting timestamps for all posts.
